title: test(lint): run the per-ownership-tier build-vs-door case as one case per tier
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

Closes #34834

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:把 `packages/lint` 里一个循环三个 ownership 层级的测试用例,拆成每个层级一个用例;断言、层级、列、站点一个不少。
- 为什么改:这个用例一次做了 180 次 build/door 判定,空闲机器约 0.65 秒,4 小时全量 CI 负载下跑到 5.26 秒,超过 5 秒单用例上限,把全量跑染红。
- 风险与回滚:只改测试文件,不发布任何东西;回滚就是 revert 这一个 commit。
- 先看:`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.flow-null-guards.test.ts` 中 "ownership tier" 那一段(唯一改动的 hunk)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-expressions.flow-null-guards.test.ts`,预期 31/31 通过,三个层级用例各约 0.2 秒。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.flow-null-guards.test.ts`: the case "on each ownership tier os build judges exactly the injected columns the tier carries, as the door does" looped the three tiers (`business_unit`, `org`, `none`) inside one `it`. It is now one `it` per tier, generated by the same loop; the body of each is the old loop body unchanged. No timeout, skip or assertion changed.

## Why this shape, not a shared fixture

Measured before changing anything (head `4443014630`, idle-ish shared box):

- The case boots nothing. Each tier is 6 columns × 5 sites = 30 `runAuthoringRules('build')` calls plus 30 `runRuntimeAuthoringRules` calls over a one-object stack; the only per-tier setup is `applyInjectedSystemColumns`, which is negligible. There is no booted fixture to hoist.
- Instrumented run of the case: total ~0.79 s; build side 0.56 s over 90 calls (~6.3 ms each), door side 0.22 s over 90 calls (~2.4 ms each).
- CPU profile of the build side: about 55% of it is `lintLivenessProperties` re-reading and parsing the spec liveness ledgers from disk on every `runAuthoringRules('build')` call (`loadWarnMap`, `readFileSync`); the rest is the expression passes themselves. That per-call ledger read is production code outside this card's file surface, so it is left alone (see Acceptance notes).
- Every (tier, column, site) input is distinct, so there is no repeated work inside the case to share. Batching several sites into one build stack would change the stack the build judges and the finding `path` (`flows[k]`), which the build-equals-door assertion compares, so it was not taken.

The case did three times the work of its un-tiered sibling ("os build refuses an unguarded ordering over each injected column ...", ~0.23 s). One case per tier puts each at that sibling's cost.

## Tests

| reading | before (one case) | after (per tier case) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| local run 1 | 650 ms | 229 / 221 / 225 ms |
| local run 2 | 683 ms | 194 / 199 / 231 ms |
| local run 3 | 651 ms | 225 / 219 / 217 ms |
| CI full run 44079718096 | 5259 ms (cap 5000) | not measured; scaled ~1.8 s each |

<details><summary>Commands and verdicts (head 5a699ff727)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/validate-expressions.flow-null-guards.test.ts` ×3 under `os-verify-lock.sh`: VERDICT command-exit 0 each; 31/31 tests (was 29/29: one case became three).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck` (tsc plus `check:test-typecheck` over `tsconfig.test.json`): VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 51 families; all 51 run locally, all exit 0 (three, `check:docs-transcript-drift`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, exited 3 on the first pass while the box was busy and exit 0 on a serial re-run); `--ran` reconciliation: 51 derived, 51 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `check-nul-bytes.mjs`: exit 0. `overlap-check.mjs`: VERDICT clean.
- No ablation: no tested behaviour changed, only how the cases are split.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `skip-changeset`: the diff is one test file; `@objectstack/lint` publishes `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` only.
- Noted, not filed: `runAuthoringRules('build')` re-reads the spec liveness ledgers on every call (about 3.4 ms of a 6.3 ms call here). A real `os build` calls it once, so the cost lands only on test suites that call it many times. carrier: none.
- Not touched: the 16:04Z full run 44121471746 failed on `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/form-field-tabs.test.tsx:275`, a different case outside this card.

## Verification

After merge, the next 4-hourly scheduled `CI` run shows the three per-tier cases in Test Core well under 5 s, and this card closes or refreshes on its own.
